# CLAP test headers

Unmodified headers from https://github.com/free-audio/clap/tree/1.2.10/include/clap
and the upstream MIT LICENSE, pinned to CLAP 1.2.10. Only native tests include
these files; none are compiled into the Plenty plugin. SHA256SUMS records the
vendored files. To update, fetch the same paths from an explicit upstream tag,
retain LICENSE, regenerate the manifest, and review native ABI assertions.
